Your health Emergency medical expenses Up to $250K (primary) When a sudden illness or injury occurs during your trip, we can help cover eligible medical expenses like hospitalization, prescription medication and doctor visits. Emergency medical evacuation Up to $500K Covers emergency transportation expenses to the nearest appropriate medical facility when an acute, severe or life-threatening illness or injury occurs, and adequate treatment is not available nearby. Speak to a doctor virtually Included Access to a global network of 20K+ telemedicine doctors while traveling internationally through our partnership with Air Doctor. Your trip Trip cancellation Up to 100% of non-refundable trip costs If you need to cancel your trip for a covered reason, including illness or a travel providerâs financial default, we can help cover non-refundable expenses like flights, hotels, tickets and activities. Whatâs covered? Covered reasons for trip cancellation When traveling with Faye, you can be reimbursed for the following covered, unforeseen events: Sickness, injury or death of insured, a family member, a travel companion or a business partner Inclement weather Residence or destination becomes uninhabitable Complications of pregnancy Financial default of an entity that directly provides travel arrangements Traffic accident Quarantined or hijacked Subpoenaed or ordered to appear in court Called into active military duty Previously granted military leave revoked Terrorist incident Documented theft of passport Felonious assault Mandatory evacuation due to a natural disaster Involuntary job termination This is a summary of select covered reasons. Please refer to your plan document for the complete list and eligibility requirements. You can also contact our team 24/7 at support@withfaye.com or via in-app chat for assistance. Trip delay Up to $3.5K/trip, capped at $250/day for delays of more than 6 hours When youâre stranded in transit for covered reasons outside your control, such as flight delay or theft of your passport, we can help cover expenses like meals, lodging and local transportation. Trip interruption Up to 150% of your non-refundable trip costs, including additional transportation expenses If a covered reason requires you to unexpectedly cut your trip short or extend your stay, we can help cover your unused trip costs and additional transportation expenses. Pre-existing medical conditions Coverage for trip cancellation or trip interruption Trip cancellation or trip interruption related to pre-existing conditions can be covered if you purchase your plan within 14 days of your initial trip deposit (e.g., flights, hotel, etc.) and are medically able to travel at the time of purchase. Trip inconvenience & snafus $200/trip inconvenience, capped at $600/trip Provides a fixed benefit when youâre inconvenienced during your trip, such as an eligible flight delay, cancellation, diversion or rental home lockout. Non-medical emergency evacuation Up to $100K Covers evacuation expenses if a covered event, such as a natural disaster or political or security emergency outside of your home country, requires transportation from a place of danger to a place of safety. Rental car care Up to $50K Coverage in the event of accidental damage to your rental car, such as collision, vandalism, natural disaster or theft related to your rental car. Learn more . Cancel For Any Reason Up to 75% of non-refundable trip costs Allows you to cancel your trip for reasons outside of your planâs trip cancellation coverage, as long as you purchase this add-on within 14 days of your initial trip deposit and cancel at least 48 hours before your scheduled departure. There may also be coverage under Trip Cancellation or Trip Interruption if there is a government-mandated shutdown of an airport, causing the complete cessation of services of an airline. Some policies may also cover situations where a home or destination becomes uninhabitable due to extreme weather. We suggest that customers review their policies to identify which coverage(s) may apply. As always, we can help–we’re available 24/7 via chat, email or phone.
